purpose: Distinguish a simple pitch from production effort; inspect mechanisms outside the previously proposed genres.
method: Targeted primary-source reading, not a systematic review or meta-analysis. Reference games were not played during this research. Developer reports are not independent causal evaluations.

references.name: Stick Fight
observations: Developer reports about three months of evenings/weekends after a one-person jam prototype.
Prototype reused the TABS physics system.
Released feature list includes up to four players and 100 maps.
references.limit: Full commercial release scope differs from a hackathon prototype; this is not a lower bound on our schedule.

references.name: ROUNDS
observations: Developer reports five months of development.
The loser of a round receives upgrades.
Released feature list includes online play, 65+ power-ups and 70+ maps.
references.limit: Does not isolate the time spent on networking, feel, assets or content.

references.name: Crawl
observations: One player is the hero, others control monsters; killing the hero transfers the hero role.
Developer describes an initial prototype made in a few days.
Early access in August 2014; full release on April 11, 2017.
Supports local multiplayer and AI opponents.
references.limit: Role inversion has an established precedent; neither global novelty nor online implementation ease follows from this reference.

references.name: One Million Checkboxes
observations: Creator reports an initial build in two days.
Creator reports over 650 million checkbox actions during two weeks before deliberately closing the site.
Article documents outages, scaling work and a server rewrite.
references.limit: Action count is not a user count or retention measure; launch distribution and bots confound comparisons.

references.name: Desktop Goose
observations: Creator distributes native Windows and macOS builds.
Character interacts with the desktop, cursor, notes and memes.
references.limit: No source-code reuse, current OS compatibility or production duration was verified.

references.name: Rapier JavaScript determinism
observations: Official documentation describes cross-platform determinism for the WASM/JavaScript version under identical version, initialization and operation ordering.
Application-side initialization can break determinism.
references.limit: A physics capability is not a complete multiplayer architecture or evidence of enjoyable gameplay.

references.name: Clash of Clans Builder Base 2.0
observations: Supercell described removal of head-to-head battles in May 2023.
Each attack opens the player base to a defense; another attack can begin without waiting for the previous opponent.
This version awards loot without stealing the other player resources.
references.limit: Describes a specific Clash mode, not every current Clash mechanic or measured demand among Chog users.

references.name: Builder Base design rationale
observations: The game lead described preserving the focused feel of smaller bases and using fewer stronger troops.
references.limit: Developer-reported design rationale and feedback; no controlled comparison or sample size supplied.

references.name: Heroes of Mavia
observations: Official documentation describes attacking player-built bases and NFT land ownership, rental or partnerships.
references.limit: Direct precedent against claiming that the bases/NFT/crypto combination is new; no activity, retention or current economic sustainability audited.

references.name: Kenney Tower Defense Kit
observations: Publisher lists a 3D asset pack under CC0 with 160 files.
references.limit: Availability and license inspected; files, animation coverage and suitability for Chog art direction not tested.

references.name: Strategy Kit: RTS Engine
observations: Asset Store lists a Unity 6000 version; publisher documentation covers unit combat, building placement and optional modules.
references.limit: No package purchased, installed or tested. Module documentation does not establish a ready-to-use asynchronous game backend or secure result verification.

decision_status: No product selected; no new gameplay prototype or user test conducted.
